item.title: #8 Tigers prime for postseason run at NAIA National Championships
item.description: WICHITA, Kan. – The #8 Campbellsville University men's wrestling team heads to the Heartland Credit Union Arena this weekend with a formidable eight-man roster for the 2026 NAIA Men's Wrestling National Championship.

item.title: Lady Tigers receive votes in initial NAIA Coaches’ Top 25 Poll
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. — The Campbellsville University Lady Tigers have earned 18 votes in the first regular-season NAIA Softball Coaches' Top 25 Poll of the 2026 season, announced by the national office on Wednesday.

item.title: Crewe-Brown set to take on NAIA National Championships
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. – As swim teams arrive at the Elkhart Health & Aquatics Center for the NAIA National Championships this week, all eyes are on Marlien Crewe-Brown to make waves for Campbellsville University on the national stage.

item.title: Tigers enter receiving votes category in first regular-season NAIA ranking
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – The Campbellsville University Tigers are receiving votes in the most recent release of the 2026 GoRout NAIA Baseball Coaches' Top 25 Poll.

item.title: Campbell, Carr, Young to compete for NAIA Championships
item.description: GAINESVILLE, Fla. – The Campbellsville University men's track and field team is ready to take flight at the 2026 NAIA Men's Indoor Track & Field National Championship, taking the Alachua County Sports and Events Center with automatic qualifiers, early-season national marks, and championship experience. From Thursday through Saturday, the Tigers aim to turn their indoor season into All-American success on the national stage.

item.title: Early leads slip away as Lady Tigers suffer two 3-2 setbacks on day one in Gulf Shores
item.description: GULF SHORES, Ala. — The (RV) Lady Tiger softball team headed south for a five-game stint at the Gulf Coast Invitational, matching up with #10 Southeastern and (RV) UT Southern on Friday afternoon. Despite strong pitching and timely hitting, Campbellsville dropped a pair of 3-2 heartbreakers to open the tournament.

item.title: Tigers cruise past Midway in straight sets
item.description: MIDWAY, Ky. — The #4 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team traveled to Marshall Gymnasium on Friday to kick off a weekend road swing against the Midway University Eagles. Firing on all cylinders, the Tigers continued their historic unbeaten run with a clean 3-0 sweep (25-16, 25-8, 25-19) to advance to 17-0 on the season.

item.title: RedStorm quelled by Tiger sweep
item.description: RIO GRANDE, Ohio. — The #4 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team hit the road to take on the University of Rio Grande RedStorm at Newt Oliver Arena on Saturday. Showing off their discipline, the Tigers took a clean sweep victory (25-19, 25-23, 25-16) over the RedStorm to continue their overwhelming success and extend their undefeated season to 18-0.

item.title: Holland's complete game shutout fuels nightcap upset
item.description: GULF SHORES, Ala. – The Lady Tigers continued their stint at the annual, prestigious Gulf Coast Invitational Saturday, facing off against the (RV) Saint Xavier Cougars and the #16 LSU Alexandria Generals. The Lady Tigers' late rally came up short in game one against Saint Xavier, falling 8-4, but a massive third-inning explosion propelled them to a 4-0 split in the nightcap against #16 LSU Alexandria.

item.title: Lady Tigers earn #2 seed; set to host NAIA 1st & 2nd Round
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The road to the Red Banner runs through the Powell Athletic Center. After compiling a 22-7 overall record and receiving an at-large bid, the Campbellsville University Lady Tigers have earned a #2 seed in the Liston Quadrant for the 2026 NAIA Women's Basketball Championship First and Second Rounds, presented by Ballogy.
